epic_description: Implement dual-mode coordination system with CLI-based cost savings and Task-tool flexibility

acceptance_criteria: Slash commands created with proper descriptions
Toggle script detects current mode from coordinator locations
Toggle script validates CLAUDE.md consistency
Script handles mismatch by prompting user
Script moves coordinator files between active/ignored directories
/cost-savings-status returns accurate mode information

phases.phase_description: Create CLI versions of all 7 coordinators with spawn-workers.js patterns
acceptance_criteria: All 7 CLI coordinators created with proper frontmatter
Each uses spawn-workers.js for worker spawning
Redis pub/sub coordination patterns included
SQLite lifecycle hooks present
Rate limit fallback documentation (GLM-4.6 → GLM-4.5)
Model set to sonnet for all coordinators

phases.phase_description: Create Task tool versions of all 7 coordinators with parallel Task spawning
acceptance_criteria: All 7 Task coordinators created with proper frontmatter
Each uses Task tool for worker spawning
No CLI spawning patterns present
Redis pub/sub coordination patterns included
SQLite lifecycle hooks present
Model set to sonnet for all coordinators

phases.phase_description: Update CLAUDE.md with dynamic sections and remove model/provider from agent profiles
acceptance_criteria: CLI mode section clearly states spawn-workers.js requirement
Task mode section clearly states Task tool requirement
Warning message for Task tool usage in CLI mode
All non-coordinator agents have model/provider removed
Coordinators keep model: sonnet declaration
Comments added explaining project-level model defaults

phases.phase_description: Implement GLM-4.6 → GLM-4.5 fallback in spawn-workers.js and test both modes
acceptance_criteria: Fallback logic implements immediate GLM-4.5 on 4xx/rate limit
Immediate retry with GLM-4.6 after fallback success
/cost-savings-on activates CLI mode correctly
/cost-savings-off activates Task mode correctly
/cost-savings-status detects mode accurately
Mismatch detection prompts user for resolution
hello-world tests pass in both modes

functionality: Both modes toggleable via slash commands
CLI fallback works on rate limits/4xx
All coordinators work in both modes

risks.mitigation: Use clear delimiters for dynamic sections
Automatic detection with user prompt on mismatch
